_note: Evolution Items (§6.3.2, §6.3.7, §7.2.5, docs/design/catalogs/consumables.md §5). The stones are the only way a stone line evolves: one is applied from the Move Manager between nodes, like a TM, never enters the combat pile, and opens the ordinary Evolution screen from `fromLevel` on; `branch` narrows that screen to the one branch the stone makes (Eevee's three). Single use. The held items a trade line levels up with are held items (held-items.json), not stones (§6.3.8).

items.name: Fire Stone
items.description: A stone with a heat that never fades. It evolves Vulpix, Growlithe, and Eevee into Flareon.

items.name: Water Stone
items.description: A clear blue stone that feels wet to the touch. It evolves Shellder, Staryu, Poliwhirl, and Eevee into Vaporeon.

items.name: Thunder Stone
items.description: A green stone with a thunderbolt caught inside. It evolves Pikachu, Magneton, and Eevee into Jolteon.

items.name: Leaf Stone
items.description: A stone with a leaf pattern grown into it. It evolves Exeggcute, Gloom and Weepinbell.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.description: A stone as black as the night it fell from. It evolves Clefairy, Jigglypuff, Nidorina and Nidorino.
